title: Team
subtitle: Your lab group: the bench, the bookings and the backups belong to the team
loadFailed: Teams could not be loaded. Reload the page.

create.title: Create a team
create.intro: Create your group's team, then invite your classmates by user name. You belong to one team at a time.
create.adminNote: As an admin you need no team to manage the benches. You may still create one.
create.name: Team name

leave.title: Leave team {team}?
leave.body: You will lose access to the team's bench and backups.
leave.last: You are the last member: the team will be dissolved, its bench released and its bookings cancelled.

calendar.hint: Click a free hour to book the bench for your team; click your slot to cancel it.
calendar.limits: At most {max} upcoming bookings per team, {hours} h each.
calendar.needTeam: Benches are booked by teams: create yours or join one in the “My team” tab.

all.removeBody: If they were the last member, the team is dissolved.
all.dissolveBody: Its members are left without a team, its bench is released and its bookings are cancelled.

notify.invited: {name} invites you to team {team}. Answer in the Team section.

errors.bad_name: A team name has {min} to {max} characters.
errors.bad_username: This is not a valid user name.
errors.already_member: You already belong to team {team}: leave it first.
errors.unknown: This team does not exist (any more).
errors.not_member: Only the members of this team may do that.
errors.full: A team has at most {max} members.
errors.too_many_invitations: Too many invitations are waiting ({max} at most).
errors.no_invitation: This invitation does not exist (any more).
